BUF.text: OL: LT Dion Dawkins (ribs, DNP all week) and OT Alec Anderson (ankle) questionable for MNF at MIN. RT Spencer Brown has no designation.

NYJ.text: WR Garrett Wilson (concussion) out at KC; Adonai Mitchell and Omar Cooper the top WRs.
RB Breece Hall back from a five-game absence; carries to be split with Braelon Allen.

CAR.text: LBs Jaelan Phillips (hamstring) and Bobby Okereke (foot), CB Will Lee III (hamstring) and G Damien Lewis (knee) ruled out vs DEN. CB Akayleb Evans on IR.

DEN.text: Secondary: CB Kris Abrams-Draine (ankle) and S Brandon Jones (hamstring) ruled out at CAR; S Talanoa Hufanga (ankle) a game-time decision.

KC.text: Secondary: CB Mansoor Delane (shoulder) out vs NYJ, CB L'Jarius Sneed (knee) on IR.

SF.text: Receivers: 49ers ruled out three wide receivers vs LV on Friday's injury report.

NYG.text: RB Cam Skattebo (hamstring) listed doubtful at PHI after missing practice; Devin Singletary would lead the backfield.

DAL.text: WR George Pickens (hamstring) questionable at IND after limited practices. S Caleb Downs (concussion) has no designation.

NO.text: LT Kelvin Banks Jr. (ankle), out since Week 2, activated from IR Saturday; questionable vs CLE.
